summary: The HTTP entry point for the AI Analyst. `POST /ai/ask` validates the question with `AskIn` (`iip/schemas.py`), rate-limits the caller and delegates to `ask` in `iip/analyst.py`, which returns the engine's decision, the cited sources and an explanation.

notes.text: Module docstring: natural-language questions about incidents and users.
Postpones evaluation of type hints (they are kept as strings); FastAPI still resolves them when it inspects each endpoint's signature.
`APIRouter`, plus `Depends` to attach the rate limiter.
The analyst service module, `iip/analyst.py` from the parent package (not this file).
`AskIn` requires a question of 3 to 500 characters.
The session alias and the rate-limit dependency.
Registers `POST /api/v1/ai/ask` with rate limiting but no API key: asking changes no data, but each question can trigger a paid OpenAI call when a key is configured, so it is throttled.
A plain `def`, so it runs in the thread pool: a slow OpenAI call (its timeout is 20 seconds) ties up one worker thread, never the event loop.
Delegates to the analyst module and returns its answer dict.
